Shipping: from Long Beach, CA, within 3 business days, with tracking, wrapped in bubble wrap in a small box. No Returns: I'm selling my old video game collection and not running a business, so please only buy if you are sure you want this. If anything arrives damaged or not as described, message me and I will sort it out.
